complex.prompt: Design a scalable distributed caching system that handles 10 million requests per day. Include architecture diagrams, consistency models, eviction strategies, and failure handling.
Analyze the mathematical foundations of attention mechanisms in transformer models. Derive the scaled dot-product attention formula and explain why scaling by sqrt(d_k) is necessary.
Write a comprehensive comparison of RLHF, Constitutional AI, and DPO as alignment techniques. Evaluate their trade-offs, failure modes, and suitability for different deployment contexts.
Implement a Python solution for the Traveling Salesman Problem using dynamic programming with bitmask. Include complexity analysis, proof of correctness, and optimization notes.
Develop a research methodology for evaluating carbon emissions in large language model training. Include experimental design, control variables, statistical analysis plan, and ethical considerations.
Architect a real-time fraud detection system for a payment processor handling 50,000 transactions per second. Address ML pipeline, feature engineering, latency constraints, and regulatory compliance.
Derive the backpropagation algorithm from first principles. Show the chain rule application, gradient computation for each layer type, and numerical stability considerations.
Compare Byzantine fault tolerance algorithms: PBFT, Tendermint, and HotStuff. Analyze safety proofs, liveness conditions, communication complexity, and performance under different network conditions.
Design a multi-tenant SaaS platform with strict data isolation, role-based access control, and audit logging. Include database schema, API design, authentication flows, and compliance considerations.

Analyze the environmental impact of training GPT-4 scale models. Calculate CO2 emissions using reported compute hours, estimate energy sources, compare to alternatives, and propose mitigation strategies.

Write a detailed technical specification for a federated learning system that preserves privacy while aggregating model updates across 1000 hospitals. Include differential privacy, secure aggregation, and byzantine resilience.

Synthesize research on the relationship between model scale, training compute, and emergent capabilities. Critically evaluate scaling laws, identify limitations, and propose future research directions.

Design a recommendation system for a streaming platform with 100 million users. Include collaborative filtering, content-based filtering, cold-start problem handling, real-time personalization, and A/B testing framework.

Provide a comprehensive security audit methodology for a cloud-native application. Include threat modeling using STRIDE, penetration testing procedures, OWASP compliance checks, and remediation prioritization.

Explain and compare Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), fine-tuning, and in-context learning for domain adaptation of LLMs. Include empirical evaluation framework, cost analysis, and deployment considerations.

Design a consensus mechanism for a permissioned blockchain targeting financial institutions. Address regulatory requirements, performance targets, validator selection, fork resolution, and auditability.

Develop a comprehensive plan to migrate a monolithic Java application to a microservices architecture. Include service decomposition strategy, data ownership, inter-service communication, testing strategy, and rollback plan.
Analyze the game-theoretic properties of multi-agent reinforcement learning systems. Discuss Nash equilibria, cooperative vs. competitive settings, reward shaping, and real-world applications.
Create a full MLOps pipeline specification for a production ML system. Include data versioning, model registry, feature store design, monitoring, drift detection, and automated retraining triggers.

Evaluate the feasibility of quantum computing acceleration for transformer inference. Analyze current quantum hardware limitations, algorithm candidates, error correction overhead, and 5-year outlook.

Design a zero-trust network architecture for a multinational enterprise with 50,000 employees across 30 countries. Include identity provider integration, micro-segmentation, device posture assessment, and incident response.
Write a formal proof that the halting problem is undecidable using diagonalization. Explain all steps clearly and discuss implications for program analysis and verification.

Analyze economic incentive structures in decentralized autonomous organizations. Compare token voting, conviction voting, and quadratic funding. Identify attack vectors and propose governance improvements.

Design a real-time analytics platform for IoT sensor data from 1 million devices. Address ingestion at 100k events/second, stream processing, time-series storage, anomaly detection, and visualization.

Critically analyze the limitations of current LLM evaluation benchmarks. Identify what they fail to measure, propose novel evaluation methodologies, and design an experiment to validate your approach.

Develop a mathematical model for carbon-aware scheduling in data centers. Formulate as an optimization problem, analyze complexity, propose heuristic solutions, and estimate achievable carbon reduction.
Architect a high-frequency trading system with microsecond latency requirements. Cover kernel bypass networking, FPGA integration, co-location strategy, order book management, and risk controls.
Compare symbolic AI and neural AI approaches for reasoning tasks. Analyze strengths and limitations, evaluate neuro-symbolic hybrid architectures, and discuss future research directions.
Write a detailed implementation of a distributed key-value store with linearizable consistency. Implement the Raft consensus algorithm in pseudocode. Analyze safety and liveness properties.

Design a global content moderation system for a social media platform with 2 billion users across 190 countries. Address language coverage, cultural context, human review queues, appeals, and regulatory compliance.
Synthesize the literature on neural architecture search (NAS). Compare evolutionary, gradient-based, and predictor-based approaches. Analyze computational costs and design a practical NAS pipeline.
Evaluate explainability methods for deep learning: SHAP, LIME, integrated gradients, and attention visualization. Compare fidelity, stability, and computational cost. Design an evaluation framework.

Design a privacy-preserving data marketplace where organizations can monetize datasets without exposing raw data. Include cryptographic protocols, pricing mechanisms, and regulatory framework compliance.

Create a comprehensive disaster recovery plan for a globally distributed financial system with RPO of 1 minute and RTO of 5 minutes. Cover multi-region replication, failover automation, and testing procedures.

Analyze the computational complexity of training large language models. Derive scaling laws empirically, explain the role of the Chinchilla findings, and discuss their implications for future model development.

Write a research proposal for measuring AI model bias across intersectional demographic groups. Include experimental design, statistical methods, dataset requirements, and ethical approval considerations.

Design a multi-modal AI system that processes text, images, and structured data for medical diagnosis support. Include model architecture, data preprocessing, uncertainty quantification, and clinical validation approach.

Analyze and compare memory architectures for continual learning: elastic weight consolidation, progressive neural networks, and experience replay. Propose an experiment to evaluate catastrophic forgetting mitigation.
Develop a formal specification for a smart contract audit. Define security properties using temporal logic, identify common vulnerability patterns, and describe a systematic verification methodology.

Design a carbon credit tokenization system on a public blockchain. Include verification methodology, oracle design, prevention of double-counting, regulatory alignment, and market liquidity considerations.
